subject_binding.registry_binding: verified-repo-registry.json exact bytes and pinned commits
subject_binding.environment_binding: environment.lock.json plus observed workflow or container environment

allowed_claims: Riverbraid-Evaluation-Kit is the current public entry and evaluation surface for the declared Riverbraid governance floor.
The repository contains a pinned 30-repository registry, expected results, a bounded command-dispatch path, container and workflow scaffolding, and public reproduction instructions.
A specific execution may claim only that the configured commands for the pinned commits produced the recorded results under the observed environment and evaluator version.
Registry command depth varies and must remain visible when interpreting any aggregate result.

current_limitations.claim_effect: The allowlist patch is present in source but successful execution and fail-closed denial evidence are still required.
The current environment does not support an immutable base-image or fully hermetic reproduction claim.
The pinned registry is a historical/current profile snapshot and must not be described as automatically fresh relative to default branches.
A registry pass does not establish equal behavioral verification depth across all 30 entries.

refused_claims: equal verification depth across all registry entries
review_triggers: execution evidence that closes or changes a listed limitation
nonclaims: This declaration does not prove that the workflow or container executed.
This declaration does not establish independent reproduction.
This declaration does not upgrade a presence check into a behavioral verifier.
This declaration does not close issues 8, 9, 10, or 11.
